The '''Cargo-Mover Tractor Beam''' was a commercial grade [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projector]] manufactured by [[Bonadan Heavy Industries]]. It was intended for use in standard cargo transfer operations, but could be adapted for illegal pursuits such as [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]].<ref name="PP" />
